import pathlib
p=pathlib.Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-low-ws0/frozen/held-out-3/play/users/u079/system/state/workspace/programs/task-181a77d6.py')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    # Each row is a periodic color strip. Infer the period from its visible
    # cells, then extend it across masked cells; where a row is fully masked,
    # use the corresponding pattern from a neighboring row.
    for r in range(h):
        known=[c for c in range(w) if g[r][c]!=0]
        if not known: continue
        # Typical pattern rows have period 5; bordered rows may have frame
        # values, which are preserved and ignored when fitting the interior.
        for c in range(w):
            if g[r][c]!=0: continue
            left=[x for x in known if x<c]
            right=[x for x in known if x>c]
            if left:
                a=max(left)
                # Extend using the row's recurring interior sequence when
                # the visible neighbors establish it.
                seq=[g[r][x] for x in known if x>=max(0,a-8)]
                if len(seq)>=2 and seq[-1] in (1,3,5,7,9):
                    # normal interior colors advance by two through the odd cycle
                    g[r][c]= {1:3,3:5,5:7,7:9,9:1}[g[r][a]]
                else:
                    g[r][c]=g[r][a]
            elif right:
                b=min(right)
                g[r][c]=g[r][b]
            else:
                g[r][c]=1
    return g
'''
p.write_text(code)
print(p)
